stemMd:
The collection includes a notebook by the fictional explorer ______ who recorded local place names during a journey through the valley. The notebook is now being transcribed by volunteers.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: The proper name identifies the explorer; the following who clause adds information about her. A comma introduces that nonessential relative clause. The clause cannot stand alone after a semicolon.

distractorRationale.c: And has no coordinated element here and incorrectly interrupts the relative-clause introduction.
distractorRationale.d: Who recorded does not form an independent clause after a semicolon.
distractorRationale.b: A colon does not correctly introduce this relative clause.
